docs.answer: There are 115 bike stations in the system.

docs.question: Which station is closest to O'Connell Bridge?
docs.answer: The closest station to O'Connell Bridge is Princes Street / O'Connell Street, just 0.215 km away in the city centre zone. The next nearest are Townsend Street (0.336 km) and Custom House (0.343 km).

docs.question: Which station has spent the most minutes empty?
docs.answer: GRANGEGORMAN LOWER (CENTRAL) has spent the most time empty, with about 407 minutes (roughly 6.8 hours) with zero bikes available.

docs.question: Which 3 stations have the highest peak-hour shortage rate?
docs.answer: The three stations with the highest peak-hour shortage rates are Phibsborough Road at 100% of peak minutes empty, Golden Lane at about 70.7%, and Portobello Road at about 59.9%. This means Phibsborough Road had no bikes available to rent for the entire peak-hour periods it was observed.

docs.question: Compare the average number of available bikes in hours with precipitation versus dry hours.
docs.answer: Across all station-hours with weather data, hours with precipitation had an average of 11.65 bikes available per station, versus 11.84 bikes in dry hours — a drop of about 0.2 bikes per station (weighted by observed minutes: 11.61 vs 11.83). So precipitation is associated with slightly fewer available bikes, though the overall difference is small.
docs.sql: SELECT had_precipitation, COUNT(*) AS hours, ROUND(CAST(AVG(avg_available_bikes) AS DECIMAL), 2) AS avg_bikes, ROUND(CAST((SUM(avg_available_bikes * observed_minutes) / SUM(observed_minutes)) AS DECIMAL), 2) AS avg_bikes_weighted FROM marts.agg_station_hourly WHERE had_precipitation IS NOT NULL GROUP BY had_precipitation ORDER BY had_precipitation LIMIT 200
